title: WASTE OF MONEY: cheap hardware, drawers fall apart
text: WASTE OF MONEY: cheap hardware, drawers fall apart. Liked the compact look & relatively simple assembly, However, manufacturer-supplied hardware is made of soft metal that twists & breaks, thus allowing drawer fronts & handles to break unbelievably easy. Definitely a regrettable purchase & frustrating waste of time. The worst part is that it would be such a hassle to disassemble & repack what REMAINS of these tables, we are unable to return them.
